description: Read the light version of one person's public profile, fetched FRESH at request time: name, location, current company name, profile_ref and the public about (often cut short) when the profile shows them. Costs $0.0005, charged only when the answer has a name plus a location or a company name; a profile that is not found, shows too little, or cannot be read right now is free. For job titles, experience, education and the person_ref that people_posts takes, use people_profile ($0.0012). Pass a public identifier or profile address as `profile_ref`. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

profile_ref.description: A person's public identifier or profile address.

name: people_profile_lite
title: Read Person Profile (Light)
